title: Anthropic to Be Listed in October, Target Valuation May Exceed $2 Trillion

content_html:
According to the Financial Times, Anthropic's investors expect the AI company to launch an IPO this October with a target valuation of $2 trillion or higher. If achieved, it would surpass the $1.77 trillion valuation of SpaceX during its June 2024 listing, becoming the largest IPO in history.

Six investors said that Anthropic's revenue has been growing rapidly, and it is expected to reach between $100 billion and $120 billion by the end of 2026, with an annual growth rate exceeding 10 times. The company announced in May that its annualized revenue had exceeded $47 billion. Investors believe that the strong demand for advanced AI models like Claude and enterprise tools is the main factor supporting the high valuation expectations.

Since 2026, venture capital firms, sovereign wealth funds, and other investors have injected nearly $100 billion into Anthropic. In May of this year, the company's valuation surpassed OpenAI for the first time, reaching $965 billion with new investments. As a reference, AI-related companies such as Palantir and Nebius currently have a price-to-sales ratio of about 55 times.

However, Anthropic's management has not yet determined the target valuation for the IPO. At the same time, the company still faces pressures such as increased competition from China, AI regulation, and tensions with the U.S. government. These factors once caused a slowdown in revenue growth in June, but sources say it has since resumed growth. As of the time of writing, Anthropic has not commented on this.

content_html_zh:
据英国《金融时报》报道，Anthropic 的投资者预计这家人工智能公司将于今年 10 月启动 IPO，目标估值达到 2 万亿美元或更高。 如果实现，它将超过 SpaceX 在 2024 年 6 月上市时的 1.77 万亿美元估值，成为历史上最大的 IPO。

六位投资者表示，Anthropic的营收一直在快速增长，预计到2026年底将达到1000亿至1200亿美元之间，年增长率超过10倍。 该公司5月份宣布年化收入已超过470亿美元。 投资者认为，对Claude等先进人工智能模型和企业工具的强劲需求是支撑高估值预期的主要因素。

自2026年以来，风险投资公司、主权财富基金和其他投资者已向Anthropic注资近1000亿美元。 今年5月，该公司估值首次超过OpenAI，新增投资达到9650亿美元。 作为参考，Palantir、Nebius等AI相关公司目前市销率约为55倍。

不过，Anthropic 管理层尚未确定 IPO 的目标估值。 与此同时，该公司仍面临来自中国的竞争加剧、人工智能监管以及与美国政府的紧张关系等压力。 这些因素一度导致6月份收入增长放缓，但消息人士称此后已恢复增长。 截至撰写本文时，Anthropic 尚未对此发表评论。
